summary: Statutory steam boiler commissioning and annual pressure testing certification under Indian Boilers Act.

steps.title: Submit manufacturer dossier
steps.description: Upload Form II, III & IV manufacturer material test reports, welder certificates, and hydraulic test certificate.

steps.title: Steam pipeline erection check
steps.description: Approved boiler inspector visits premises to inspect safety valves, water gauges, and steam pipeline alignment.

steps.title: Hydraulic pressure testing
steps.description: Conduct hydrostatic pressure test at 1.5 times the maximum allowable working pressure witnessed by the inspector.

steps.title: Steam test & safety valve setting
steps.description: Verify safety valves pop open at calibrated working pressure without pressure surge.

steps.title: Grant of Boiler Certificate
steps.description: Receive Form VI certificate authorizing steam generation for 12 months.
